_about: What each lesson scene needs. make_lesson_props.py refuses a segment whose mode, anchors, content or assets don't match; scenes.ts maps the same names to components. 'anchors' must be in the config's anchors and fall inside the scene's segment; 'content' keys must be in the segment's content (any {"at": spec} in content is resolved to a time and checked the same way); 'assets' are image files the config stages.
